From d6a57588666301acd9d42d3b00d74240964f07f6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiadong Zhu <Jiadong.Zhu@amd.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2023 08:38:15 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amdgpu: disable MCBP by default

Disable MCBP(mid command buffer preemption) by default as old Mesa
hangs with it. We shall not enable the feature that breaks old usermode
driver.

Fixes: 50a7c8765ca6 ("drm/amdgpu: enable mcbp by default on gfx9")
Signed-off-by: Jiadong Zhu <Jiadong.Zhu@amd.com>
Acked-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
index 5c0817cbc7c2..1cc1ae2743c1 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c
@@ -3791,10 +3791,6 @@ static void amdgpu_device_set_mcbp(struct amdgpu_device *adev)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 	else if (amdgpu_mcbp == 0)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = false;
-	else if ((amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) >= IP_VERSION(9, 0, 0)) &&
-		 (amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) < IP_VERSION(10, 0, 0)) &&
-		 adev->gfx.num_gfx_rings)
-		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 
 	if (amdgpu_sriov_vf(adev))
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_device.c`**
   - The code block that sets the `adev->gfx.mcbp` (mid command buffer preemption) flag has been modified.
   - The condition that enables MCBP for certain versions of the GPU (specifically between versions 9.0.0 and 10.0.0) has been removed.
   - The default behavior is now to disable MCBP unless explicitly set otherwise, addressing compatibility issues with older Mesa drivers.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `amdgpu_device.c` directly addresses a bug related to the MCBP feature, which was previously enabled by default for certain GPU versions. By disabling it by default, the patch aims to prevent system hangs experienced with older user-mode drivers, thus improving compatibility and stability. The change is a response to a specific issue identified in a previous commit (50a7c8765ca6) that enabled MCBP by default, indicating a corrective action to revert that behavior.

Here is the commit message:
drm/amdgpu: disable MCBP by default

Disable MCBP(mid command buffer preemption) by default as old Mesa
hangs with it. We shall not enable the feature that breaks old usermode
driver.

Fixes: 50a7c8765ca6 ("drm/amdgpu: enable mcbp by default on gfx9")
Signed-off-by: Jiadong Zhu <Jiadong.Zhu@amd.com>
Acked-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by the mid command buffer preemption (MCBP) feature being enabled by default for certain GPU versions, which leads to compatibility issues and system hangs with older Mesa drivers. This indicates that the MCBP feature may not be fully supported or stable in those older drivers, resulting in failures when the feature is active.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void amdgpu_device_set_mcbp(struct amdgpu_device *adev)
 {
 	if (amdgpu_mcbp == 1)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 	else if (amdgpu_mcbp == 0)
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = false;
-	else if ((amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) >= IP_VERSION(9, 0, 0)) &&
-		 (amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) < IP_VERSION(10, 0, 0)) &&
-		 adev->gfx.num_gfx_rings)
-		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 
 	if (amdgpu_sriov_vf(adev))
 		adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
 
 	if (adev->gfx.mcbp)
 		DRM_INFO("MCBP is enabled\n");
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
else if ((amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) >= IP_VERSION(9, 0, 0)) &&
         (amdgpu_ip_version(adev, GC_HWIP, 0) < IP_VERSION(10, 0, 0)) &&
         adev->gfx.num_gfx_rings)
    adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
```
Reason:
This code checks if the GPU version is between 9.0.0 and 10.0.0 and if there are graphics rings available, enabling the MCBP feature by default. This can lead to compatibility issues with older Mesa drivers, causing system hangs when the feature is active.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (amdgpu_mcbp == 1)
    adev->gfx.mcbp = true;
else if (amdgpu_mcbp == 0)
    adev->gfx.mcbp = false;
```
Reason:
The patch modifies the logic to disable MCBP by default unless explicitly enabled by setting `amdgpu_mcbp` to 1. This prevents the automatic enabling of MCBP for certain GPU versions, thus avoiding the compatibility issues with older Mesa drivers.
